newsitem.title: EU: EP TEMPORARY COMMITTEE OF INQUIRY INTO BSE AGENDA - JAN 13.
newsitem.headline: EP TEMPORARY COMMITTEE OF INQUIRY INTO BSE AGENDA - JAN 13.

text.p: TEMPORARY COMMITTEE OF INQUIRY INTO BSE Public MEETING,

1. Adoption of draft agenda (PE 220.545) 2. Chairman's announcements 3. Approval of minutes of meetings of: - 3 December 1996 (PE 220.540) - 9-10 December 1996 (PE 220.542) - 12 December 1996 (PE 220.543) 4. Final report on BSE (PE 220.544/B) Rapporteur: Manuel MEDINA ORTEGA - Consideration of draft report - Deadline for tabling amendments 5. Any other business 6. Date and place of next meeting (The next meeting will be held on Wednesday 15 January 1997 from 3 to 6.30 p.m. in Strasbourg.) - FIN - END OF DOCUMENT.
